title: Interaction: Chronal Overdrive × collision / rank
keywords: magic interaction Chronal Overdrive   collision / rank
answer: Chronal Overdrive × collision / rank: Every new wall contact fractures a time seal; Motion may spend one collision-checked backward Second Step, Might may spend one non-damaging eight-body pressure corona, Veil clears at most eight visible hostile target memories per beat, and Dominion bends at most sixteen approaching hostile projectiles once.
